👉 70% of you said you’re open to Palmerston North joining with other councils.
👉 Manawatū was the most commonly preferred partner, followed by Horowhenua and Rangitīkei.
👉 You saw potential benefits like better infrastructure, regional planning and transport, while also highlighting concerns about costs, local representation, and protecting Palmerston North's identity and local services.

You can now drop off clean, dry soft plastics at:
👉 Ferguson Street Recycling Centre
👉 The Warehouse
👉 Woolworths at The Plaza
👉 New World Broadway

Things like bread bags, chip packets, cereal bags, courier bags, frozen food bags, bubble wrap, dairy product bags, dry pet food bags and toilet paper wrapping can all be recycled through the scheme.

We're delivering the trial in partnership with The Packaging Forum's Soft Plastics Recycling Scheme. The collected plastics will be turned into useful new products like fence posts, courier bags, boards and panels.

👏 Chris, congratulations on your well-deserved appointment! Ngā mihi nui for everything you’ve contributed to our organisation over the past seven years.

While we’re sad to see you go, we know Central Districts Water will be in a safe pair of hands.

We're incredibly proud of Jess and everything she's achieved for our city! He’s also a big believer in bringing the community along for the ride, choosing sustainable options where he can, and stretching the budget in smart ways so we get the most fun for every dollar.

    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">Soft plastic recycling is officially available in Palmy. ♻️ 🙌 

We've recently kicked off a 12-month trial, giving our community a free and easy way to recycle soft plastics instead of sending them to landfill.

It's already off to a great start too! In just the first two days, we collected 15 bags of soft plastics at Ferguson Street Recycling Centre alone.

You can now drop off clean, dry soft plastics at:
👉 Ferguson Street Recycling Centre
👉 The Warehouse
👉 Woolworths at The Plaza
👉 New World Broadway

Things like bread bags, chip packets, cereal bags, courier bags, frozen food bags, bubble wrap, dairy product bags, dry pet food bags and toilet paper wrapping can all be recycled through the scheme.

We're delivering the trial in partnership with The Packaging Forum's Soft Plastics Recycling Scheme. The collected plastics will be turned into useful new products like fence posts, courier bags, boards and panels.

You can learn more about the trial and what you can and can't recycle on our website: <a class="link" href="http://pncc.govt.nz/softplastics?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" rel="nofollow" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>pncc.govt.nz/softplastics</a></p>

Chris has led the establishment of <a class="link" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/centraldistrictswater?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Central Districts Water</a> over the past year as Executive Director, working alongside us, <a class="link" href="https://nz.linkedin.com/company/horowhenua-district-council?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Horowhenua District Council</a>, <a class="link" href="https://au.linkedin.com/company/rangitikeidc?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Rangitīkei District Council</a>, iwi partners and other stakeholders to build the new organisation from the ground up.

He has more than 30 years’ experience across local government, infrastructure, telecommunications, energy and health. 

More than seven of those years were spent with us at Palmerston North City Council! Over that time, he’s held several senior leadership roles, including Deputy Chief Executive, Acting Chief Executive, Chief Infrastructure Officer and Chief Customer Officer.

👏 Chris, congratulations on your well-deserved appointment! Ngā mihi nui for everything you’ve contributed to our organisation over the past seven years.

While we’re sad to see you go, we know <a class="link" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/centraldistrictswater?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Central Districts Water</a> will be in a safe pair of hands. 

We’re looking forward to continuing to work alongside you as <a class="link" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/centraldistrictswater?trk=organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" target="_self" data-tracking-control-name="organization_guest_main-feed-card-text" data-tracking-will-navigate>Central Districts Water</a> begins delivering water services for our communities from next July. ❤️</p>

        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">Meet Glen, our playground mastermind! 🙌 

He’s the Parks Project Officer behind the awesome play spaces at Memorial Park, Milverton Park, the new Franklin playground and plenty more across the city. 

Glen’s whole thing is making sure every playground has its own personality, not just the same swing-and-slide setup in a different spot. He’s always on the lookout for unique features that fit the area, spark imagination, and make kids light up the moment they arrive. 

He’s also a big believer in bringing the community along for the ride, choosing sustainable options where he can, and stretching the budget in smart ways so we get the most fun for every dollar.

What he loves most is the teamwork behind it all. Glen’s quick to shout out his crew who help turn the ideas into real spaces. He also enjoys working with local contractors and suppliers, keeping things local and building great relationships along the way. 

And at the heart of it: he genuinely enjoys knowing his work makes families happy, and that our parks and playgrounds are free for everyone to enjoy. 

So, next time you see kids having the time of their lives at one of our parks, there’s a fair chance Glen had a hand in making that happen! 😉 </p>
